# Security Policy — generated by init-workspace.ps1

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, **do not open a public issue**.
Please report it via one of the following channels:

- Email the maintainer (see CODEOWNERS)
- Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: https://github.com/USER/REPO/security/advisories

We aim to acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and provide a fix timeline within 5 business days.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| latest  | ✅        |
| older   | ❌        |

## Disclosure Policy

We follow a coordinated disclosure process. Please allow time for a fix before public disclosure.
